description: Main window: dragging the window by its top bar (macOS overlay title bar; on Windows our top bar is the whole title bar, with its own minimise / maximise / close buttons),local SQLite store, OS notifications, the unread badge, external links in the system browser, saving a download where the user picked in the save dialog, the credential-store commands, the `chikuwachat://` link that launched the app (Google sign-in), and in-app updates (check, download and install, then relaunch).
